description: Start a gift for someone. Give a catalog_id from find_gifts (or any product_url from a store), the recipient’s first name, and optionally their email or US mobile so they can see it in their own assistant. save:"preview" (default) shows the gift; save:"save" returns a link the sender opens to approve and pay on befana.app. Nothing is charged by this tool, and the recipient’s address is never asked for: they give it to Befana privately when they accept.

note.description: A short note from the sender

option.description: Chosen product options by name, e.g. {"Size":"9"}; names and values come from find_gifts

recipient_email.description: Lets the recipient find the gift when signed in to Befana with this email. Never shown to anyone

recipient_phone.description: US mobile, same purpose as the email

save.description: preview (default) shows what would happen and keeps nothing; save does it. Only use save after the person said yes to the preview.

surprise.description: true keeps the gift itself a surprise until it arrives

name: send_gift
title: Send a gift
